description: An Encased Fan turns rotation into an air current.

pages.title: Encased Fans
pages.text:
An **Encased Fan** turns rotation into an air current. Items caught in it, on the ground, on a belt or a depot, get **bulk processed** depending on what the air passes through.\
\
Speed only changes the range, not the processing speed.

pages.title: Encased Fan
pages.text: Direction follows rotation. The air also pushes mobs, players and dropped items.

**Base types**:

- Washing: air through water

- Smoking: fire or campfire

- Blasting: lava

- Haunting: soul fire or soul campfire

Washing: [#](2E5AAC)[Crushing](entry://create_basics/crushing)[#]().

Blasting works like a furnace and would burn food: smoke it instead. A **Blaze Burner** also works as a blasting and smoking source, and the Lit Blaze Burner variant for haunting, see [#](2E5AAC)[Heat](entry://create_basics/heat)[#]().\
\
Bars, fences and leaves let air through; solid blocks stop it.

**Added by other mods**:

- Dragons Plus: ending (dragon breath), freezing (powder snow), sanding (quicksand), coloring (liquid dye), enchanting (Golden Aercloud)

- Create Nuclear: enriching

- Enchantment Industry: salvaging

pages.title: Enriching Campfire
pages.text: Create Nuclear's fan catalyst for bulk enriching. Enriched fire comes from Enriched Soul Soil, see [#](2E5AAC)[Nuclear](entry://industry/nuclear)[#]().
